description: This Java source file implements a SOAP event handler for the OFBiz web application framework. It handles SOAP request and response processing, WSDL retrieval, and service invocation via SOAP protocol, integrating with OFBiz services and utility classes.

classes.name: SOAPEventHandler
classes.description: Implementation of a SOAP event handler for processing SOAP requests, handling WSDL requests, invoking involved OFBiz services, and returning SOAP responses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the given servlet context.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method to process incoming SOAP requests, handle WSDL retrieval, or invoke services based on SOAP envelope contents.

methods.name: validateSOAPBody
methods.description: Validates that the SOAP body contains exactly one service call request.

methods.name: createAndSendSOAPResponse
methods.description: Constructs a SOAP response message with service results and sends it in the HTTP response.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Helper methods to send error messages in SOAP response format.

methods.name: getLocationURI
methods.description: Constructs the location URI from the request for WSDL and service invocation purposes.
